rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
# As in Debian: without the time of the build in the version string. export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -U__DATE__ -U__TIME__"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-libgdbm-compat \ --enable-largefile \ --disable-nls
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
ln -sf ndbm.h "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/gdbm-ndbm.h"
